name: wave-slider
title: Wave Slider
description: A compact volume control that remembers the level before muting.
useCases: In a player, a listener sets volume on a 0–100 scale. The app converts the percentage to an audio level.
In an ambient sound editor, the app restores the saved level through value and updates the mix as the user moves the slider.
task: A compact volume control that remembers the level before muting.
behavior: Volume ranges from 0 to 100. Use defaultValue for local state or supply value with onValueChange for external control.
